# SQL School

> > ISO-certified IT training institute in Hyderabad specializing in SQL Server, Azure, Power BI, Python, and data engineering courses with real-time expert instruction.

SQL School has been providing hands-on developer training since 2008, focusing on Microsoft technologies including SQL Server, Azure Data Engineer, MSBI (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS), Power BI, and emerging AI/ML technologies. The institute offers live online training with real-time project experience for data professionals, BI developers, and full-stack developers.

## Key Topics

- SQL Server & T-SQL
- Azure Data Engineering
- Power BI & Business Intelligence
- Python for Data Science
- ETL Development (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS)
- Microsoft Fabric
- Oracle PL/SQL
- DevOps & CI/CD
- AI/ML Integration
- Database Administration (DBA)
- Real-time training methodology
- ISO certification
- Hyderabad IT training
- Live online courses
- Data warehousing
